title: #21 Industrialization
prompt: In the 18th century due to industrialization, a lot of people migrated to developed countries. This affected lifestyle and increased problems in developed countries. What is your opinion about this?

promptSegments.text: In the 18th century due to industrialization, a lot of people migrated to developed countries.
This affected lifestyle and increased problems in developed countries.
What is your opinion about this?

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ quan điểm bằng hai lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Dùng ví dụ phù hợp khi chúng làm rõ ý.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The sudden influx of people into new cities led to severe overcrowding and strained local facilities, as housing could not accommodate the large population increase.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The sudden influx of people into new cities led to severe overcrowding and strained local facilities, as housing could not accommodate the large population increase.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Furthermore, the local job market struggled to keep pace with the new arrivals, causing existing residents to lose job opportunities.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Furthermore, the local job market struggled to keep pace with the new arrivals, causing existing residents to lose job opportunities.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: People moving to rich countries help these areas grow by providing needed skills and energy to the local economy.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: People moving to rich countries help these areas grow by providing needed skills and energy to the local economy.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: These people contribute to the development of better city facilities and improved quality of life.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: These people contribute to the development of better city facilities and improved quality of life.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first point discusses how the sudden increase in population (migration) put pressure on existing public services and infrastructure, leading to resource strain.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The first point discusses how the sudden increase in population (migration) put pressure on existing public services and infrastructure, leading to resource strain.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The second point focuses on the social difficulties, specifically the struggle of local services and the community to adapt to a large influx of new people.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The second point focuses on the social difficulties, specifically the struggle of local services and the community to adapt to a large influx of new people.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Migration provides needed workers, helping to strengthen economies and fill job gaps.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Migration provides needed workers, helping to strengthen economies and fill job gaps.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Immigrants contribute positively to local economies through taxes and starting new businesses.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Immigrants contribute positively to local economies through taxes and starting new businesses.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.

promptTraps.en: Do not explain the statement without making your own position clear.

modelPlan.focus: Analyze the impact of 18th-century industrialization on migration and its effects on developed countries' lifestyles and problems.
keyArguments: Industrialization led to mass migration, which changed lifestyles and caused overcrowding.
While migration brought economic benefits, it also strained social services and infrastructure.
